theorem1iiPriorReferenceZeroBiasSpec.tex_statement: For finite types X and Y with decidable equality, a joint PMF \mu on X \times Y, scores q : X \to Y \to \mathbb{R}, and a rule X \to Y, every label y has zero prior-reference bias whenever perfectClassifierOnSupport \mu q rule holds.

theorem1ii_prior_reference_zero_bias_on_.tex_statement: For all finite types X and Y with decidable equality, joint PMFs \mu, score functions q, and deterministic rules, theorem1iiPriorReferenceZeroBiasSpec \mu q rule holds.

theorem1iiAggregateReferenceZeroBiasSpec.tex_statement: For finite types X and Y with decidable equality, a joint PMF \mu on X \times Y, scores q : X \to Y \to \mathbb{R}, and a rule X \to Y, every label y has zero aggregate-posterior-reference bias whenever perfectClassifierOnSupport \mu q rule holds.

theorem1ii_aggregate_reference_zero_bias.tex_statement: For all finite types X and Y with decidable equality, joint PMFs \mu, score functions q, and deterministic rules, theorem1iiAggregateReferenceZeroBiasSpec \mu q rule holds.

theorem2iiiParetoOptimalAgreesArgmaxSpec.tex_statement: For finite X with decidable equality, N,K, a feature PMF \mu, posterior scores, an independent rule and fixed-order argmax rule, a dataset aggregate-argmax selector, and a dataset-indexed reference prefAt: if the argmax rule satisfies isFirstArgmax pointwise, sourcePNq holds, and N>0, then Pareto optimality of the sampled independent policy implies \Pr_{\mu}[rule(x) \ne argmaxRule(x)] = 0, where expected fidelity uses prefAt at each sampled dataset.

theorem2iii_source_pareto_optimal_agrees.tex_statement: For all finite X with decidable equality and all displayed PMF, posterior, independent-rule, fixed-order-argmax, aggregate-selector, and dataset-dependent-reference inputs, theorem2iiiParetoOptimalAgreesArgmaxSpec holds.

theorem2iiiWeightedObjectiveMaximizerAgr.tex_statement: For finite X with decidable equality, N,K, a feature PMF \mu, posterior scores, an independent rule and fixed-order argmax rule, a dataset aggregate-argmax selector, a dataset-indexed reference prefAt, and \gamma \in [0,1): if the argmax rule satisfies isFirstArgmax pointwise, sourcePNq holds, N>0, and the sampled independent policy maximizes the expected \gamma-weighted accuracy/fidelity objective among all dataset policies, then \Pr_{\mu}[rule(x) \ne argmaxRule(x)] = 0; expected fidelity evaluates prefAt at each sampled dataset.

theorem2iii_source_weighted_objective_ma.tex_statement: For all finite X with decidable equality and all displayed PMF, posterior, independent-rule, fixed-order-argmax, aggregate-selector, dataset-dependent-reference, and real \gamma inputs, theorem2iiiWeightedObjectiveMaximizerAgreesArgmaxSpec holds.

accuracy.tex_statement: {N K : ℕ} (truth decision : Fin N \to Fin K) = EconCSLib.Decision.datasetAccuracy truth decision

aggregatePosterior.tex_statement: Definition `aggregatePosterior` has inputs b/0 (parameter): ℕ; b/1 (parameter): ℕ; b/2 (parameter): Fin N → Fin K → ℝ; b/3 (parameter): Fin K. It concludes result: ℝ := Real.mul✝ (∑ i, q i y) (↑N)⁻¹.

bayesOptimal_formula.tex_statement: \forall {\Omega : Type u_1} {\sigma : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype \Omega] [inst_1 : DecidableEq \Omega] [inst_2 : Fintype \sigma] [inst_3 : DecidableEq \sigma] {N K : ℕ} (\mu : PMF \Omega) (observedDataset : \Omega \to \sigma) (trueLabels : \Omega \to Fin N \to Fin K) (posterior : \sigma \to Fin N \to Fin K \to ℝ), bayesOptimal \mu observedDataset trueLabels posterior \iff \forall (xs : \sigma) (i : Fin N) (y : Fin K), (pmfProb \mu fun w  =>  observedDataset w = xs \land trueLabels w i = y) = posterior xs i y * pmfProb \mu fun w  =>  observedDataset w = xs

bias.tex_statement: Definition `bias` has inputs b/0 (parameter): ℕ; b/1 (parameter): ℕ; b/2 (parameter): Fin N → Fin K; b/3 (parameter): Fin K → ℝ; b/4 (parameter): Fin K. It concludes result: ℝ := Real.add✝ (DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.marginalLabelShare decision y) (-pref y).

calibrated_formula.tex_statement: \forall {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace (X × Y)] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Y] (\mu : Measure (X × Y)) (q : X \to Y \to ℝ), calibrated \mu q \iff \forall (y : Y) (s : Set ℝ), MeasurableSet s \to \int (xy : X × Y), if q xy.1 y \in s then if xy.2 = y then 1 else 0 else 0 ∂\mu = \int (xy : X × Y), if q xy.1 y \in s then q xy.1 y else 0 ∂\mu

classifierMAE.tex_statement: Definition `classifierMAE` has inputs b/0 (parameter): Type u_1; b/1 (parameter): Type u_2; b/2 (parameter): Fintype X; b/3 (parameter): DecidableEq X; b/4 (parameter): Fintype Y; b/5 (parameter): DecidableEq Y; b/6 (parameter): PMF (X × Y); b/7 (parameter): X → Y → ℝ. It concludes result: ℝ := Quot.lift (fun l => List.foldr (fun x1 x2 => x1 + x2) 0 l) ⋯ (Multiset.map (fun a => ((DSWG24DiscretizationBias.Finite.featureMarginal μ) a).toReal * (fun x => ∑ y, q x y * (1 - q x y)) a) Finset.univ.val).

continuousAggregateBias.tex_statement: Definition `continuousAggregateBias` has inputs b/0 (parameter): Type u_1; b/1 (parameter): Type u_2; b/2 (parameter): MeasurableSpace X; b/3 (parameter): DecidableEq Y; b/4 (parameter): MeasureTheory.Measure X; b/5 (parameter): X → Y → ℝ; b/6 (parameter): X → Y; b/7 (parameter): Y. It concludes result: ℝ := Real.add✝ (DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.continuousMarginalLabelShare μ rule y) (-DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.continuousAggregatePosterior μ q y).

continuousAggregatePosterior.tex_statement: Definition `continuousAggregatePosterior` has inputs b/0 (parameter): Type u_1; b/1 (parameter): Type u_2; b/2 (parameter): MeasurableSpace X; b/3 (parameter): MeasureTheory.Measure X; b/4 (parameter): X → Y → ℝ; b/5 (parameter): Y. It concludes result: ℝ := ∫ (x : X), q x y ∂μ.

It concludes result: ℝ := Real.add✝ (DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.continuousMarginalLabelShare μ rule y) (-pref y).

continuousClassifierMAE.tex_statement: Definition `continuousClassifierMAE` has inputs b/0 (parameter): Type u_1; b/1 (parameter): Type u_2; b/2 (parameter): MeasurableSpace X; b/3 (parameter): Fintype Y; b/4 (parameter): MeasureTheory.Measure X; b/5 (parameter): X → Y → ℝ. It concludes result: ℝ := ∫ (x : X), ∑ y, q x y * (1 - q x y) ∂μ.

continuousJointClassifierMAE.tex_statement: Definition `continuousJointClassifierMAE` has inputs b/0 (parameter): Type u_1; b/1 (parameter): Type u_2; b/2 (parameter): MeasurableSpace (X × Y); b/3 (parameter): Fintype Y; b/4 (parameter): MeasureTheory.Measure (X × Y); b/5 (parameter): X → Y → ℝ. It concludes result: ℝ := ∫ (xy : X × Y), ∑ y, q xy.1 y * (1 - q xy.1 y) ∂μ.

continuousJointPriorBias.tex_statement: Definition `continuousJointPriorBias` has inputs b/0 (parameter): Type u_1; b/1 (parameter): Type u_2; b/2 (parameter): MeasurableSpace (X × Y); b/3 (parameter): DecidableEq Y; b/4 (parameter): MeasureTheory.Measure (X × Y); b/5 (parameter): X → Y; b/6 (parameter): Y. It concludes result: ℝ := Real.add✝ (∫ (xy : X × Y), if rule xy.1 = y then 1 else 0 ∂μ) (-∫ (xy : X × Y), if xy.2 = y then 1 else 0 ∂μ).

continuousMarginalLabelShare.tex_statement: Definition `continuousMarginalLabelShare` has inputs b/0 (parameter): Type u_1; b/1 (parameter): Type u_2; b/2 (parameter): MeasurableSpace X; b/3 (parameter): DecidableEq Y; b/4 (parameter): MeasureTheory.Measure X; b/5 (parameter): X → Y; b/6 (parameter): Y. It concludes result: ℝ := ∫ (x : X), if rule x = y then 1 else 0 ∂μ.

equation1Objective.tex_statement: {N K : ℕ} (\gamma : ℝ) (q : Fin N \to Fin K \to ℝ) (pref : Fin K \to ℝ) (decision : Fin N \to Fin K) = \gamma * EconCSLib.Decision.averageScore q decision + (1 - \gamma) * fidelity decision pref

equation2ExpectedAccuracy.tex_statement: {\omega \sigma : Type*} {N K : ℕ} (expect : (\omega \to ℝ) \to ℝ) (observedDataset : \omega \to \sigma) (trueLabels : \omega \to Fin N \to Fin K) (rule : \sigma \to Fin N \to Fin K) = EconCSLib.Decision.expectedDecisionAccuracy expect observedDataset trueLabels rule

equation3ExpectedObjective.tex_statement: {\omega \sigma : Type*} {N K : ℕ} (expect : (\omega \to ℝ) \to ℝ) (observedDataset : \omega \to \sigma) (trueLabels : \omega \to Fin N \to Fin K) (\gamma : ℝ) (prefAt : \sigma \to Fin K \to ℝ) (rule : \sigma \to Fin N \to Fin K) = \gamma * equation2ExpectedAccuracy expect observedDataset trueLabels rule + (1 - \gamma) * expectedFidelityAt expect observedDataset prefAt rule

expectedBiasAt.tex_statement: {\omega \sigma : Type*} {N K : ℕ} (expect : (\omega \to ℝ) \to ℝ) (observedDataset : \omega \to \sigma) (prefAt : \sigma \to Fin K \to ℝ) (rule : \sigma \to Fin N \to Fin K) (y : Fin K) = expect (fun w  =>  bias (rule (observedDataset w)) (prefAt (observedDataset w)) y)

expectedFidelityAt.tex_statement: {\omega \sigma : Type*} {N K : ℕ} (expect : (\omega \to ℝ) \to ℝ) (observedDataset : \omega \to \sigma) (prefAt : \sigma \to Fin K \to ℝ) (rule : \sigma \to Fin N \to Fin K) = EconCSLib.Decision.expectedObjective expect observedDataset (fun xs decision  =>  fidelity decision (prefAt xs)) rule

expectedObjective.tex_statement: Definition `expectedObjective` has inputs b/0 (parameter): Type u_1; b/1 (parameter): Type u_2; b/2 (parameter): ℕ; b/3 (parameter): ℕ; b/4 (assumption): NeZero K; b/5 (parameter): (ω → ℝ) → ℝ; b/6 (parameter): ω → σ; b/7 (parameter): ω → Fin N → Fin K; b/8 (parameter): ℝ; b/9 (parameter): σ → (Fin N → Fin K) → ℝ; b/10 (parameter): σ → Fin N → Fin K. It concludes result: ℝ := Real.add✝ (γ * EconCSLib.Decision.expectedDecisionAccuracy expect observedDataset trueLabels rule) ((1 - γ) * EconCSLib.Decision.expectedObjective expect observedDataset fidelityTerm rule).

fidelity.tex_statement: Definition `fidelity` has inputs b/0 (parameter): ℕ; b/1 (parameter): ℕ; b/2 (parameter): Fin N → Fin K; b/3 (parameter): Fin K → ℝ. It concludes result: ℝ := Real.neg✝ (∑ y, |DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.bias decision pref y|).

isAggregateFirstArgmax_formula.tex_statement: \forall {N K : ℕ} (posterior : Fin N \to Fin K \to ℝ) (target : Fin K), isAggregateFirstArgmax posterior target \iff isFirstArgmax (aggregatePosterior posterior) target

isArgmaxRule_formula.tex_statement: \forall {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} (q : X \to Y \to ℝ) (rule : X \to Y), isArgmaxRule q rule \iff \forall (x : X) (y : Y), q x y \le q x (rule x)

isFirstArgmax_formula.tex_statement: \forall {K : ℕ} (score : Fin K \to ℝ) (chosen : Fin K), isFirstArgmax score chosen \iff (\forall (y : Fin K), score y \le score chosen) \land \forall (y : Fin K), score y = score chosen \to ↑chosen \le ↑y

isIndependentRandomizedRule_formula.tex_statement: \forall {X : Type u_1} {N K : ℕ} (jointProbability : (Fin N \to X) \to (Fin N \to Fin K) \to ℝ), isIndependentRandomizedRule jointProbability \iff \exists rowProbability, \forall (xs : Fin N \to X) (decision : Fin N \to Fin K), jointProbability xs decision = \prod i, rowProbability (xs i) (decision i)

isIndependentRule_formula.tex_statement: \forall {X : Type u_1} {N K : ℕ} (rule : (Fin N \to X) \to Fin N \to Fin K), isIndependentRule rule \iff \exists d, \forall (xs : Fin N \to X) (i : Fin N), rule xs i = d (xs i)

isThompsonSamplingRule_formula.tex_statement: \forall {N K : ℕ} (q selectionProbability : Fin N \to Fin K \to ℝ), isThompsonSamplingRule q selectionProbability \iff \forall (i : Fin N) (y : Fin K), selectionProbability i y = q i y

isTieBrokenArgmaxRule_formula.tex_statement: \forall {N K : ℕ} (q : Fin N \to Fin K \to ℝ) (rule : Fin N \to Fin K), isTieBrokenArgmaxRule q rule \iff \forall (i : Fin N), isFirstArgmax (q i) (rule i)

marginalLabelShare.tex_statement: Definition `marginalLabelShare` has inputs b/0 (parameter): ℕ; b/1 (parameter): ℕ; b/2 (parameter): Fin N → Fin K; b/3 (parameter): Fin K. It concludes result: ℝ := Real.mul✝ (∑ i, if decision i = y then 1 else 0) (↑N)⁻¹.

maximizesEquation1_formula.tex_statement: \forall {N K : ℕ} (\gamma : ℝ) (q : Fin N \to Fin K \to ℝ) (pref : Fin K \to ℝ) (decision : Fin N \to Fin K), maximizesEquation1 \gamma q pref decision \iff \forall (other : Fin N \to Fin K), equation1Objective \gamma q pref other \le equation1Objective \gamma q pref decision

objective.tex_statement: Definition `objective` has inputs b/0 (parameter): ℕ; b/1 (parameter): ℕ; b/2 (parameter): Type u_1; b/3 (parameter): ℝ; b/4 (parameter): σ → Fin N → Fin K → ℝ; b/5 (parameter): σ → (Fin N → Fin K) → ℝ; b/6 (parameter): σ; b/7 (parameter): Fin N → Fin K. It concludes result: ℝ := Real.add✝ (γ * EconCSLib.Decision.averageScore (posterior xs) decision) ((1 - γ) * fidelityTerm xs decision).

paretoOptimal_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Rule : Type u_1} (accuracyMetric fidelityMetric : Rule \to ℝ) (rule : Rule), paretoOptimal accuracyMetric fidelityMetric rule \iff ParetoOptimal accuracyMetric fidelityMetric rule

perfectClassifierOnSupport_formula.tex_statement: \forall {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype X] [inst_1 : DecidableEq X] [inst_2 : Fintype Y] [inst_3 : DecidableEq Y] (\mu : PMF (X × Y)) (q : X \to Y \to ℝ) (rule : X \to Y), perfectClassifierOnSupport \mu q rule \iff \forall (x : X) (y : Y), \mu (x, y) \ne 0 \to rule x = y \land q x y = 1 \land \forall (a : Y), a \ne y \to q x a = 0

posteriorSimplex_formula.tex_statement: \forall {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] (q : X \to Y \to ℝ), posteriorSimplex q \iff (\forall (x : X), \sum y, q x y = 1) \land (\forall (x : X) (y : Y), 0 \le q x y) \land \forall (x : X) (y : Y), q x y \le 1

prior.tex_statement: Definition `prior` has inputs b/0 (parameter): Type u_1; b/1 (parameter): Type u_2; b/2 (parameter): Fintype X; b/3 (parameter): DecidableEq X; b/4 (parameter): Fintype Y; b/5 (parameter): DecidableEq Y; b/6 (parameter): PMF (X × Y); b/7 (parameter): Y. It concludes result: ℝ := ((DSWG24DiscretizationBias.Finite.labelMarginal μ) y).toNNReal.1.

referenceSimplexAt_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Sample : Type u_1} {K : ℕ} (prefAt : Sample \to Fin K \to ℝ), referenceSimplexAt prefAt \iff \forall (sample : Sample), (\forall (y : Fin K), 0 \le prefAt sample y) \land \sum y, prefAt sample y = 1

sourcePNq_formula.tex_statement: \forall {Sample : Type u_1} {N K : ℕ} (posterior : Sample \to Fin N \to Fin K \to ℝ) (aggregateArgmax : Sample \to Fin K) (prefAt : Sample \to Fin K \to ℝ), sourcePNq posterior aggregateArgmax prefAt \iff referenceSimplexAt prefAt \land (\forall (sample : Sample), isAggregateFirstArgmax (posterior sample) (aggregateArgmax sample)) \land \forall (sample : Sample), 1 / ↑N \le prefAt sample (aggregateArgmax sample)

sourceSa_formula.tex_statement: \forall {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} (q : X \to Y \to ℝ) (z : Y), sourceSa q z = {x | q x z = 1}

sourceSb_formula.tex_statement: \forall {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] (q : X \to Y \to ℝ) (z : Y), sourceSb q z = {x | (↑(card Y))⁻¹ < q x z \land q x z < 1}

sourceSc_formula.tex_statement: \forall {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] (q : X \to Y \to ℝ) (z : Y), sourceSc q z = {x | q x z = (↑(card Y))⁻¹}

sourceSd_formula.tex_statement: \forall {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Y] (q : X \to Y \to ℝ) (z : Y), sourceSd q z = {x | 0 < q x z \land q x z < (↑(card Y))⁻¹}

sourceSe_formula.tex_statement: \forall {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} (q : X \to Y \to ℝ) (z : Y), sourceSe q z = {x | q x z = 0}

It concludes result: (DSWG24DiscretizationBias.Finite.paperBias μ (fun x => z) (DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.prior μ) y = if z = y then 1 - DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.prior μ y else -DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.prior μ y) ∧ DSWG24DiscretizationBias.Finite.paperBias μ (fun x => z) (DSWG24DiscretizationBias.Finite.paperAggregatePosterior μ q) y = if z = y then 1 - DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.prior μ y else -DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.prior μ y.

theorem1iii_argmax_bias_le_mae.tex_statement: Theorem `theorem1iii_argmax_bias_le_mae` has inputs b/0 (parameter): Type u_1; b/1 (parameter): Type u_2; b/2 (parameter): MeasurableSpace X; b/3 (parameter): MeasurableSpace Y; b/4 (assumption): MeasurableSingletonClass Y; b/5 (parameter): Fintype Y; b/6 (parameter): DecidableEq Y; b/7 (parameter): MeasureTheory.Measure (X × Y); b/8 (assumption): MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ; b/9 (parameter): X → Y → ℝ; b/10 (parameter): X → Y; b/11 (parameter): Y; b/12 (assumption): Measurable argmaxRule; b/13 (assumption): DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.isArgmaxRule q argmaxRule; b/14 (assumption): DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.posteriorSimplex q; b/15 (assumption): ∀ (y : Y), Measurable fun xy => q xy.1 y; b/16 (assumption): DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.calibrated μ q. It concludes result: DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.continuousJointPriorBias μ argmaxRule y ≤ DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.continuousJointClassifierMAE μ q.

theorem2i_joint_rule_exists.tex_statement: Theorem `theorem2i_joint_rule_exists` has inputs b/0 (parameter): Type u_1; b/1 (parameter): Type u_2; b/2 (parameter): ℕ; b/3 (parameter): ℕ; b/4 (assumption): NeZero K; b/5 (assumption): 2 ≤ K; b/6 (assumption): K < N; b/7 (parameter): (ω → ℝ) → ℝ; b/8 (assumption): EconCSLib.Decision.FiniteLinearExpectation expect; b/9 (parameter): ω → σ; b/10 (parameter): ω → Fin N → Fin K; b/11 (parameter): ℝ; b/12 (parameter): σ → Fin N → Fin K → ℝ; b/13 (parameter): σ → (Fin N → Fin K) → ℝ; b/14 (assumption): ∀ (i : Fin N) (choose : σ → Fin K), (expect fun x => if choose (observedDataset x) = trueLabels x i then 1 else 0) = expect fun x => posterior (observedDataset x) i (choose (observedDataset x)). It concludes result: ∃ optRule, ∀ (rule : σ → Fin N → Fin K), DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.expectedObjective expect observedDataset trueLabels γ fidelityTerm rule ≤ DSWG24DiscretizationBias.PaperInterface.expectedObjective expect observedDataset trueLabels γ fidelityTerm optRule.

It concludes result: EconCSLib.Decision.expectedDecisionAccuracy expect observedDataset trueLabels decisionRule ≤ EconCSLib.Decision.expectedDecisionAccuracy expect observedDataset trueLabels argmaxRule.

thresholdRule.tex_statement: {N K : ℕ} (t : ℝ) (q : Fin N \to Fin K \to ℝ) (argmaxRule : Fin N \to Fin K) (i : Fin N) = if t \le q i (argmaxRule i) then some (argmaxRule i) else none
